$comment: Services. Each item becomes a card, a /services/<slug> page, a footer link and a sitemap entry. `pricing` names a category id in treatments.json, so the detail page can show its price list. Dentists list the slugs they perform in doctors.json.

section.title: Complete care for you and your family.
section.intro: From preventive check-ups to full smile makeovers — every treatment, planned around you.

items.title: General Dentistry
items.excerpt: Routine checkups, cleanings & preventive care for a lifetime of healthy smiles.
items.description: Preventive dentistry is the most affordable dentistry there is. Regular examinations, professional cleaning and early intervention keep small problems from becoming expensive ones.

faq.a: Twice a year for most patients. If you have gum disease or wear braces, we usually recommend every three to four months.
No. Scaling removes hardened plaque from the tooth surface. Any sensitivity afterwards settles within a few days.

items.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
items.excerpt: Enhance your smile with veneers, bonding, whitening & more.

image.alt: Shade matching for cosmetic dental veneers

items.description: A smile design begins with your face, not your teeth. We photograph, measure and simulate the result digitally so you approve the smile before a single tooth is prepared.

faq.a: Not when they are layered by hand and matched to your natural shade. You see a trial smile in your own mouth before we finalise anything.
Ten to fifteen years with good hygiene, and longer if you avoid using your front teeth to bite hard objects.

items.title: Dental Implants
items.excerpt: Permanent, natural-looking solution for missing teeth.

image.alt: Dental implant model on a clinical table

items.description: An implant replaces the root of the tooth, so the bone stays healthy and the neighbouring teeth are left untouched. We place implants under CBCT-guided surgical planning.
includes: CBCT scan and guided surgical planning
Single tooth, multiple and full-arch implants
Immediate loading where bone quality allows
Bone grafting and sinus lift procedures

faq.a: The placement is done under local anaesthesia and most patients return to work the next day. Mild swelling for two to three days is normal.
If you have adequate bone volume and controlled general health, yes. The CBCT scan at your consultation answers this precisely.

items.title: Orthodontics
items.excerpt: Braces & aligners to straighten teeth and boost confidence.

image.alt: Clear aligner trays for orthodontic treatment

items.description: Straight teeth are easier to clean and distribute bite forces evenly. We offer metal, ceramic and fully invisible aligner systems for teenagers and adults.

faq.a: Aligners suit mild to moderate crowding and adults who cannot wear visible braces. Complex bite corrections still respond faster to fixed braces.
No. Bone remodels at every age. Our oldest orthodontic patient started at 61.

items.title: Root Canal Therapy
items.excerpt: Relieve pain & save your natural tooth with advanced care.

image.alt: Dental operatory prepared for endodontic treatment

items.description: Modern endodontics is quiet, precise and usually completed in a single sitting. Rotary instrumentation and an apex locator let us clean the canal accurately without guesswork.
includes: Rubber dam isolation for a sterile field
Apex locator and digital radiographic verification
Re-treatment of previously failed root canals

faq.a: The procedure relieves pain rather than causing it. Profound local anaesthesia means most patients feel pressure, not pain.

faq.q: Do I need a crown afterwards?
faq.a: In almost all back teeth, yes. A treated tooth is brittle and a crown prevents it from fracturing.

items.title: Teeth Whitening
items.excerpt: Safe & effective whitening for a brighter smile.
items.description: In-clinic whitening lifts stains several shades in a single appointment, with a desensitising protocol built into the visit so you leave comfortable.
includes: Custom take-home trays with day gel

faq.a: Twelve to eighteen months for most people. Coffee, tea and tobacco shorten that considerably.
No. Ceramic and composite do not respond to bleaching agents, so we plan shade matching around this.
